label: Document filter (Search)
type: an 8.0+ custom filter selecting which documents in a scope/collection are indexed, based on field values - distinct from a type mapping's document-type inclusion/exclusion.
evidence: Custom: As of Couchbase Server version 8.0, custom document filters select only documents that match a custom filter, based on the values of specific fields.
If mode is custom, provide an object that sets a custom document filter for a scope and collection in your Search index.
relates_to_competency_question: Beyond type mapping, can a Search index filter which documents it indexes by field VALUE, not just field presence?
